newsitem.title: USA: Deere unit files $1 bln debt, warrant shelf.
newsitem.headline: Deere unit files $1 bln debt, warrant shelf.

text.p: John Deere Capital Corp, a unit of Deere & Co filed Wednesday a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $1 billion in debt securities and warrants.
When combined with a previous registration, Deere will have a total offering of $1.15 billion in debt securities available for sale.
Net proceeds will be added to general funds and used for working capital and other general corporate purposes, the company said in the filing.

John Deere, based in Moline, Ill., provides and administers financing for retail purchases of new and used equipment manufactured by Deere & Co's agricultural, construction, commercial and consumer equipment divisions.
